CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.
   C. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   C. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   B. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Forgiveness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Helping the Needy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the lost coin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the mustard seed and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. C — Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
